responses.message: Do you know someone named Spencer?

messages: Been years since I seen a Kariba.
What can I do for ya?

suite.message: Name's Eugene. Been working in Ashtown since I was about your age.
This place has gone south ever since the Bandit showed up and started swiping people's packages.
And always will be, if I got any say in the matter. I love my job.
We get lots of letters and packages via train from Nightside and Grand Island. Lots of folks here left their friends and folks behind to earn an honest living.
I came here after my mom died. It was her last wish for me to get off Grand Island and make a new life for myself.
At first we lived in Nightside together, but I moved here after Skycorps drafted her for some secret project. I haven't seen her since.
Say, if you ever find yourself in Nightside, could you leave this at the post office? It'd mean a whole lot to me.
It's the most important letter I've got, and the only one I can't deliver...
Spencer? Yeah, he's that kid who got kidnapped by the Ashtown Bandit.
No one's seen him in months, and people are beginning to fear the worst...
Yeah. Never heard of him? You must be new in town.
Ain't a single soul around here sleeping with both eyes closed, thanks to him.
You got a good soul. That's a rare treasure, these days.
